The main force of the 26th Red Army moved to exterior lines while local guerrillas held the Zhaojin and Nanliang areas. Start and end months follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 1934 年 10 月，国民党粤军陈济棠部在赣南安远、信丰、赣州间构筑第一道封锁线，以堡垒群控制红军西进通道。中央红军于 10 月 21 日至 25 日突破该线，经信丰、安远进入湘南。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1934, Chen Jitang’s Guangdong troops built the first blockade line between Anyuan, Xinfeng and Ganzhou in southern Jiangxi, using blockhouses to control the Red Army’s westward route. The Central Red Army broke through between October 21 and 25 and entered southern Hunan via Xinfeng and Anyuan. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: KMT Second Blockade Line (Hunan and Guangdong Armies)

place.en: Between Rucheng, Hunan and Chengkou, Guangdong

summary.zh: 国民党军在汝城—城口间构筑第二道封锁线，红军于 11 月 5—8 日突破。
summary.en: KMT forces built the second blockade line between Rucheng and Chengkou; the Red Army broke through on 5–8 November.

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月初，蒋介石令湘军何键、粤军陈济棠在湖南汝城至广东城口间构筑第二道封锁线，以碉堡群控制湘粤通道。11 月 1 日，中革军委令红一军团夺取城口、红三军团夺取汝城；红一军团第二师第六团第一营急行军 220 余里，于 11 月 2 日夜袭占城口；汝城守敌较多，红军以一部监视，主力于 11 月 5 日从汝城、城口间分三路通过，至 11 月 8 日全部突破封锁线。本坐标为汝城—城口间代表点，具体碉堡线待考。
description.en: In early November 1934, Chiang Kai-shek ordered He Jian’s Hunan troops and Chen Jitang’s Guangdong troops to build the second blockade line between Rucheng in Hunan and Chengkou in Guangdong, using blockhouses to control the Hunan–Guangdong corridor. On 1 November the CMC ordered the First Army Corps to take Chengkou and the Third Army Corps to take Rucheng. The 1st Battalion of the 6th Regiment, Second Division, marched over 220 li and seized Chengkou by night on 2 November. Rucheng was too strongly held, so the Red Army monitored it and moved the main force through the Rucheng–Chengkou gap in three columns from 5 November, completing the breakthrough by 8 November. The coordinate is a representative point between Rucheng and Chengkou; the exact blockhouse line awaits verification.

name.zh: 国民党军湘江封锁线（湘军、桂军）

summary.zh: 国民党军以湘江为第四道封锁线，湘军由全州南下、桂军由兴安与灌阳北上，企图夹击中央红军。
summary.en: Kuomintang forces used the Xiang River as a fourth blockade line, with Hunan troops driving south from Quanzhou and Guangxi troops north from Xing’an and Guanyang to trap the Central Red Army.

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月，国民党军以第四路军（何键部）和桂军（白崇禧部）等依托湘江构筑第四道封锁线，集结重兵堵截中央红军。湘军刘建绪部由全州南下，桂军由兴安、灌阳北上，企图在湘江以东夹击红军。红军在屏山、大坪、凤凰嘴、界首等渡口和新圩、脚山铺、光华铺等阻击阵地与敌激战，最终突破封锁线，但伤亡重大。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1934, Kuomintang forces including the Fourth Route Army (He Jian) and Guangxi forces (Bai Chongxi) established a fourth blockade line along the Xiang River and concentrated troops to intercept the Central Red Army. Liu Jianxu’s Hunan troops drove south from Quanzhou while Guangxi troops moved north from Xing’an and Guanyang, seeking to crush the Red Army east of the river. The Red Army fought at the Pingshan, Daping, Fenghuangzui, and Jieshou ferries and at the Xinxu, Jiaoshanpu, and Guanghuapu blocking positions before breaking through at heavy cost. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

place.zh: 广西兴安界首渡口（湘江战役主渡口）
place.en: Jieshou Ferry, Xing’an, Guangxi (main crossing of the Xiang River battle)

summary.zh: 中央红军在兴安、全州、灌阳间强渡湘江，突破第四道封锁线，由八万余人锐减至三万余人。
summary.en: The Central Red Army crossed the Xiang River between Xing’an, Quanzhou, and Guanyang, breaking the fourth blockade line and falling from over 80,000 to about 30,000 troops.

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月 27 日至 12 月 1 日，中央红军在广西兴安、全州、灌阳之间的湘江上游抢渡，突破国民党军第四道封锁线。红军先后控制屏山、大坪、凤凰嘴、界首等渡口，以新圩、脚山铺、光华铺三大阻击战掩护中央纵队渡江。11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日，军委第一、第二纵队从界首浮桥渡江；红五、红八、红九军团等部则在下游凤凰嘴涉渡。12 月 1 日下午界首浮桥被炸毁，担任后卫的红五军团第三十四师、红三军团第十八团被阻于湘江以东，损失惨重。此役后中央红军由出发时的八万余人锐减至三万余人。
description.en: From 27 November to 1 December 1934, the Central Red Army crossed the upper Xiang River between Xing’an, Quanzhou, and Guanyang in Guangxi, breaking the Kuomintang’s fourth blockade line. The Red Army controlled the Pingshan, Daping, Fenghuangzui, and Jieshou ferries in succession and used the Xinxu, Jiaoshanpu, and Guanghuapu blocking battles to cover the crossing of the central column. On 30 November and 1 December, the First and Second Columns of the Military Commission crossed over the Jieshou pontoon bridge, while the Fifth, Eighth, and Ninth Army Corps forded downstream at Fenghuangzui. When the Jieshou bridge was blown up on the afternoon of 1 December, the rearguard Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps and the Eighteenth Regiment of the Third Army Corps were cut off east of the river and suffered heavy losses. The Central Red Army fell from more than 80,000 troops at the start of the Long March to about 30,000.

place.zh: 广西灌阳水车镇（灌江沿岸）
place.en: Shuiche, Guanyang, Guangxi (along the Guan River)

summary.zh: 红五军团第三十四师担任全军总后卫，在道县蒋家岭至灌阳水车一线节节阻击，12 月 1 日被阻于湘江东岸。
summary.en: The Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps served as the army’s final rearguard, fighting delaying actions from Jiangjialing in Daoxian to Shuiche in Guanyang before being cut off east of the Xiang River on 1 December.

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月 27 日至 29 日，红五军团第三十四师奉命在湖南道县蒋家岭、永安关、雷口关一线节节阻击追敌，掩护红八、红九军团西进。29 日 15 时，中革军委电令该师赶赴灌阳新圩接防，30 日晨在水车一带掩护红八军团离开灌阳，随即遭桂军飞机轰炸和地面进攻。12 月 1 日，该师由水车赶往枫树脚接防时，渡口和道路已被切断，全师被阻于湘江东岸。此后经全州安和文塘、灌阳板桥铺等地突围，损失惨重，余部转战湘南。本坐标为水车镇代表点，具体阵地范围待实地核对。
description.en: From 27 to 29 November 1934, the Thirty-Fourth Division of the Fifth Army Corps fought delaying actions at Jiangjialing, Yong’an Pass, and Leikou Pass in Daoxian, Hunan, covering the westward movement of the Eighth and Ninth Army Corps. At 15:00 on 29 November the Military Commission ordered the division to relieve the defenses at Xinxu, Guanyang. At dawn on 30 November it covered the Eighth Army Corps’ departure from Guanyang at Shuiche, then came under air attack and ground assault by Guangxi troops. On 1 December, as the division moved from Shuiche toward Fengshujiao, the ferries and roads were already cut, leaving the whole division stranded east of the Xiang River. It subsequently broke out through Wentang in Anhe, Quanzhou, and Banqiaopu in Guanyang at heavy cost, with survivors continuing to fight in southern Hunan. This coordinate is the representative point of Shuiche town; the exact position of the defensive line awaits field verification.

aliases.zh: 红军长征突破湘江第一渡
aliases.en: First Ferry of the Xiang River Breakthrough

place.zh: 广西全州凤凰镇大坪村与绍水镇洛口村之间
place.en: Between Daping Village, Fenghuang, and Luokou Village, Shaoshui, Quanzhou, Guangxi

summary.zh: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，红一军团主力最早由此渡过湘江，被称为“突破湘江第一渡”。
summary.en: One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle, where the main force of the First Army Corps made the earliest crossing, known as the “first ferry of the Xiang River breakthrough.”

description.zh: 大坪渡口位于全州县凤凰镇大坪村与绍水镇洛口村之间的湘江上，东岸为大坪村，西岸为洛口村，是全州历史上的古渡。1934 年 11 月 27 日凌晨，红一军团第二师及红一师第二团趁桂军南撤之机，从大坪渡口渡过湘江，成为湘江战役中最早过江的红军部队，因此被称为“红军长征突破湘江第一渡”。随后红一军团控制了屏山至界首约 30 公里的湘江渡口。本坐标为根据里程与河道走向推算的近似位置，待现场实测。
description.en: Daping Ferry crosses the Xiang River between Daping Village in Fenghuang and Luokou Village in Shaoshui, Quanzhou. In the early hours of 27 November 1934, the Second Division of the First Army Corps and the Second Regiment of the First Division crossed here while Guangxi troops were withdrawing south, making them the earliest Red Army units across the Xiang River and earning the site the name “first ferry of the Xiang River breakthrough.” The First Army Corps then controlled the ferries along some 30 km of river from Pingshan to Jieshou. This coordinate is estimated from distances and river alignment and awaits field verification.

place.zh: 广西灌阳新圩镇（枫树脚、板桥铺、酒海井一带）
place.en: Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi (Fengshujiao, Banqiaopu, and Jiuhaijing area)

summary.zh: 红三军团第五师在新圩阻击北上桂军，是湘江战役三大阻击战的首战。
summary.en: The Fifth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Xinxu, the first of the three major blocking battles of the Xiang River campaign.

description.zh: 新圩位于灌阳县西北部，是灌阳通往湘江的必经之路。1934 年 11 月 28 日拂晓，红三军团第五师在新圩、枫树脚、板桥铺一线阻击北上的桂军，战斗持续三天，伤亡 2000 余人；红六师第十八团接防后大部牺牲。新圩阻击战是湘江战役三大阻击战的首战，保住了中央红军前往湘江渡口的通道。现建有新圩阻击战酒海井红军纪念园。
description.en: Xinxu lies in northwestern Guanyang on the route from Guanyang to the Xiang River. At dawn on 28 November 1934, the Fifth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked the northward advance of Guangxi troops at Xinxu, Fengshujiao, and Banqiaopu. The three-day battle cost more than 2,000 casualties; the Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, which took over the position, was largely destroyed. As the first of the three major blocking battles, Xinxu kept open the Central Red Army’s route to the Xiang River ferries. The Xinxu Blocking Battle Jiuhai Well Red Army Memorial Park now stands nearby.

place.zh: 广西全州才湾镇脚山铺（觉山铺）

summary.zh: 红一军团在脚山铺阻击南下湘军，是湘江战役中投入兵力最多、红军牺牲最大的阻击战。
summary.en: The First Army Corps blocked the southward advance of Hunan troops at Jiaoshanpu, the largest and costliest blocking battle of the Xiang River campaign.

description.zh: 脚山铺又称觉山铺，位于全州县才湾镇，北距全州城约 15 公里，南距界首渡口约 30 公里，桂黄公路穿山而过。1934 年 11 月 29 日起，红一军团第二师及第一师在脚山铺、鲁板桥、白沙河一线阻击湘军刘建绪部。战斗持续三天，红一军团伤亡约 2000 人，红五团政委易荡平牺牲，完成了掩护中央纵队和后续部队渡江的任务。现地建有红军长征湘江战役纪念园、纪念馆。
description.en: Jiaoshanpu, also written Jueshanpu, lies in Caiwan, Quanzhou, about 15 km from Quanzhou town and 30 km from Jieshou Ferry, where the Guilin–Huangshahe road cuts through the hills. From 29 November 1934, the Second Division and First Division of the First Army Corps blocked Liu Jianxu’s Hunan troops along the Jiaoshanpu, Lubanqiao, and Baisha River line. The three-day battle cost the First Army Corps about 2,000 casualties, including the death of Fifth Regiment commissar Yi Dangping, but covered the crossing of the central column and follow-up units. The Red Army Long March Xiang River Battle Memorial Park and Museum now stand at the site.

place.zh: 广西兴安界首镇南光华铺（桂黄公路旁）
place.en: Guanghuapu south of Jieshou, Xing’an, Guangxi (beside the Guilin–Huangshahe road)

summary.zh: 红三军团第四师在光华铺阻击北上桂军，保卫界首渡口，红十团两任团长先后牺牲。
summary.en: The Fourth Division of the Third Army Corps blocked Guangxi troops advancing north at Guanghuapu to protect Jieshou Ferry; two successive commanders of the Tenth Regiment were killed.

description.zh: 光华铺位于兴安县界首镇南约 3 至 5 公里、桂黄公路旁，是界首渡口的南面屏障。1934 年 11 月 28 日红三军团第四师接防界首后，以第十团前出光华铺，阻击由兴安北上的桂军。29 日夜间至 12 月 1 日，双方在光华铺、渠口、石门一线反复争夺，红十团团长沈述清、师参谋长杜中美先后牺牲，红三军团伤亡约 1000 人，掩护军委纵队从界首渡江。
description.en: Guanghuapu lies about 3–5 km south of Jieshou, Xing’an, beside the Guilin–Huangshahe road, and formed the southern shield of Jieshou Ferry. After the Fourth Division of the Third Army Corps took over the Jieshou defenses on 28 November 1934, it pushed the Tenth Regiment forward to Guanghuapu to block Guangxi troops advancing north from Xing’an. From the night of 29 November to 1 December, the two sides fought repeatedly over Guanghuapu, Qukou, and Shimen. Tenth Regiment commander Shen Shuqing and corps chief of staff Du Zhongmei were killed in succession, and the Third Army Corps suffered about 1,000 casualties while covering the crossing of the Military Commission’s columns at Jieshou.

name.en: Eighteenth Regiment’s Blocking Action at Xinxu

place.zh: 广西灌阳新圩镇楠木山村、陈家背一带
place.en: Nanmushan and Chenjiabei, Xinxu, Guanyang, Guangxi

summary.zh: 红三军团第六师第十八团在新圩楠木山接防，以一团之众阻击桂军数个师，几乎全部牺牲。
summary.en: The Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, Third Army Corps, took over at Nanmushan near Xinxu and blocked several Guangxi divisions with a single regiment, suffering near-total losses.

description.zh: 1934 年 11 月 30 日黄昏，红三军团第六师第十八团在新圩接替伤亡惨重的红五师，担负阻击桂军、掩护后续部队渡江的任务。据国防部报道，团长曾春鉴、参谋长吴子雄决定以两个营扼守楠木山村附近的炮楼山，一个营布防陈家背；另有资料称团长姓名至今未查清。12 月 1 日拂晓，桂军向楠木山阵地猛攻，红军弹药耗尽后展开白刃格斗。炮楼山失守后，部队向陈家背靠拢，又在向湘江转移途中被分割包围于全州古岭头一带，1800 余人大部分牺牲。本坐标为楠木山村附近代表点，具体阵地待实地核对。
description.en: At dusk on 30 November 1934, the Eighteenth Regiment of the Sixth Division, Third Army Corps, relieved the badly mauled Fifth Division at Xinxu and took over the task of blocking Guangxi troops to cover the crossing of follow-up units. According to the Ministry of National Defense account, commander Zeng Chunjian and chief of staff Wu Zixiong deployed two battalions on Paolou Hill near Nanmushan and one battalion at Chenjiabei; other sources state that the commander’s name has never been established. At dawn on 1 December, Guangxi troops stormed the Nanmushan positions, and the Red Army, its ammunition exhausted, fought hand to hand. After Paolou Hill fell the unit fell back toward Chenjiabei and was then surrounded and split apart near Gulingtou in Quanzhou while moving toward the Xiang River; most of its more than 1,800 men were killed. This coordinate is a representative point near Nanmushan village; the exact positions await field verification.

place.en: Pingshan, Jinping Village, Jiantang, Quanzhou, Guangxi

summary.zh: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，红一军团第一师由此渡过湘江赶赴脚山铺。
summary.en: One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle, where the First Division of the First Army Corps crossed to reach Jiaoshanpu.

description.zh: 屏山渡口位于全州县枧塘镇金屏村屏山屯湘江两岸，距全州城约 10 公里，渡口宽约 500 米，南北两岸为石山，下游有拦河堰可涉渡。1934 年 11 月 30 日凌晨，红一军团第一师从湖南道县急行军赶到，由屏山渡渡过湘江，与从大坪渡江的红二师在脚山铺会合，参加阻击湘军的战斗。本坐标为根据里程与河道走向推算的近似位置，待现场实测。
description.en: Pingshan Ferry lies on the Xiang River at Pingshan, Jinping Village, Jiantang, Quanzhou, about 10 km from Quanzhou town. The ferry is about 500 m wide, flanked by rocky hills, with a downstream weir that can be forded. At dawn on 30 November 1934, the First Division of the First Army Corps arrived from Daoxian in Hunan by forced march, crossed at Pingshan, and joined the Second Division at Jiaoshanpu to block the Hunan troops. This coordinate is estimated from distances and river alignment and awaits field verification.

place.en: Jieshou, Xing’an, Guangxi, on the Xiang River near Sanguantang (Red Army Hall)

summary.zh: 湘江战役主渡口，军委第一、第二纵队于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 1 日由浮桥渡过湘江。
summary.en: The main crossing of the Xiang River battle, where the First and Second Columns of the Military Commission crossed over a pontoon bridge on 30 November–1 December.

description.zh: 界首渡口位于兴安县界首镇湘江边，与全州县相邻，是湘江上游的重要古渡。1934 年 11 月 30 日凌晨，军委第一纵队在工兵架设的浮桥上游过湘江；第二纵队随红三军团行动，当日黄昏渡江。12 月 1 日下午，工兵奉命炸毁浮桥。渡口西岸的三官堂（红军堂）曾是红军渡江指挥部，彭德怀、朱德、周恩来等在此指挥渡江与阻击战。
description.en: Jieshou Ferry lies on the Xiang River at Jieshou, Xing’an, near the border with Quanzhou, and was an important ancient crossing on the upper Xiang. At dawn on 30 November 1934, the First Column of the Military Commission crossed over a pontoon bridge built by engineers; the Second Column, moving with the Third Army Corps, crossed at dusk that day. On the afternoon of 1 December, engineers blew up the bridge on orders. Sanguantang (Red Army Hall) on the west bank served as the crossing command post, where Peng Dehuai, Zhu De, and Zhou Enlai directed the crossing and blocking battles.

place.en: Jian’ansi, Heping Village, Fenghuang, Quanzhou, Guangxi

summary.zh: 湘江战役四大渡口之一，也是红军牺牲最多的渡口；界首浮桥被炸后，后续部队改由此涉渡。
summary.en: One of the four ferries of the Xiang River battle and the crossing with the heaviest Red Army casualties; follow-up units forded here after the Jieshou bridge was destroyed.

description.zh: 凤凰嘴渡口位于全州县凤凰镇和平村建安司湘江边，又名麻子渡，与上游约 10 公里的界首渡口隔江相望。1934 年 12 月 1 日，界首浮桥被炸毁后，红九军团、红五军团第十三师、红八军团等部改由凤凰嘴渡口及下游董家堰涉渡。渡口江面开阔、两岸无遮蔽，红军遭敌机轰炸和追兵射击，伤亡惨重，是湘江战役中牺牲最多的渡口。1934 年 9 月红六军团西征时也曾在此渡过湘江。本坐标为根据里程与河道走向推算的近似位置，待现场实测。
description.en: Fenghuangzui Ferry, also called Mazidu, lies on the Xiang River at Jian’ansi, Heping Village, Fenghuang, Quanzhou, about 10 km downstream of Jieshou. On 1 December 1934, after the Jieshou pontoon bridge was destroyed, the Ninth Army Corps, the Thirteenth Division of the Fifth Army Corps, the Eighth Army Corps, and other units forded here and at the Dongjiayan weir downstream. The open river and exposed banks left the Red Army vulnerable to air attack and pursuing fire, making this the deadliest crossing of the campaign. The Sixth Army Corps had also crossed here during its westward expedition in September 1934. This coordinate is estimated from distances and river alignment and awaits field verification.

place.zh: 湖南道县蚣坝镇石马神村麒麟庙
place.en: Qilin Temple, Shimashen Village, Gongba, Daoxian, Hunan

summary.zh: 红三十四师师长陈树湘在道县石马神村被俘途中断肠明志，年仅 29 岁。
summary.en: Thirty-Fourth Division commander Chen Shuxiang, while being carried prisoner through Shimashen in Daoxian, tore open his own wound and died aged 29.

description.zh: 1934 年 12 月，红三十四师完成掩护主力渡江后折返湘南。12 月 10 日，师长陈树湘在江华牯子江渡口战斗中腹部重伤；12 日，余部在道县四马桥早和田遭伏，陈树湘与警卫员在馒头岭冯督庙（洪都庙）附近被俘。12 月 18 日上午，道县保安团将其押往县城，行至蚣坝镇石马神村麒麟庙休息时，陈树湘趁敌不备，从腹部伤口绞断肠子，壮烈牺牲，年仅 29 岁。本坐标为石马神村代表点，麒麟庙遗址具体位置待实测。
description.en: In December 1934, after covering the main force’s crossing, the Thirty-Fourth Division turned back toward southern Hunan. On 10 December commander Chen Shuxiang was gravely wounded in the abdomen at the Guzijiang ferry in Jianghua; on 12 December the remnants were ambushed at Zaohetian near Simaqiao, Daoxian, and Chen and his guards were captured near Fengdu Temple (Hongdu Temple) at Mantouling. On the morning of 18 December, as the Daoxian security regiment carried him toward the county town, the party stopped to rest at Qilin Temple in Shimashen Village, Gongba. Chen seized the moment, tore open his abdominal wound, and died aged 29. This coordinate is a representative point for Shimashen village; the exact site of Qilin Temple awaits field verification.

summary.zh: 国民党黔军王家烈部依托乌江设防，企图阻止红军北上遵义。
summary.en: Guizhou troops under Wang Jialie defended the Wu River to block the Red Army’s advance on Zunyi.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月，黔军第 25 军副军长兼教导师师长侯之担部在乌江北岸茶山关、孙家渡、江界河、袁家渡、回龙场等 10 余处渡口部署 5 个团又 1 个机炮营，防线长约 200 里，并毁船、拆房、构筑工事，企图阻止红军北渡。红军分三路从江界河、回龙场、茶山关等渡口突破，至 1 月 6 日全部渡江。本坐标为江界河渡口代表点，防线沿乌江展开。
description.en: In January 1935, Hou Zhidan, deputy commander of the Guizhou 25th Army and commander of the training division, deployed five regiments and one machine-gun/artillery battalion at more than ten ferries on the north bank of the Wu River, including Chashanguan, Sunjiadu, Jiangjiehe, Yuanjiadu, and Huilongchang. The line was about 200 li long; the defenders destroyed boats, demolished houses, and built fortifications to block the Red Army. The Red Army broke through at Jiangjiehe, Huilongchang, Chashanguan, and other ferries, crossing completely by 6 January. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiangjiehe Ferry; the line extended along the Wu River.

summary.en: The Central Red Army forced the Wu River at Jiangjiehe, Huilongchang, and Chashanguan and advanced on Zunyi.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月 1 日至 6 日，中央红军分三路强渡乌江：红 1 军团第 2 师第 4 团在江界河、红 1 师第 1 团在回龙场、红 3 军团在茶山关等渡口渡江。红军以竹筏、浮桥突破黔军侯之担部防线，击溃黔军 4 个团、2 个营约 4000 人，至 6 日全部渡过乌江，进占遵义。此役是长征以来第一个较大胜利，为遵义会议召开创造了条件。本坐标为江界河渡口代表点。
description.en: From 1 to 6 January 1935 the Central Red Army crossed the Wu River in three routes: the 4th Regiment of the 2nd Division, First Army Corps, at Jiangjiehe; the 1st Regiment of the 1st Division at Huilongchang; and the Third Army Corps at Chashanguan and other ferries. Using bamboo rafts and pontoon bridges, the Red Army broke the defense line of Hou Zhidan’s Guizhou troops, routed four regiments and two battalions (about 4,000 men), and by 6 January had crossed the river and entered Zunyi. It was the first major victory since the Long March began and created conditions for the Zunyi Conference. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiangjiehe Ferry.

summary.en: The 1st Regiment, 1st Division, forced the Wu River at Huilongchang; the main force of the First Army Corps and the 9th Army Corps crossed there.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月 1 日，红 1 军团第 1 师第 1 团在团长杨得志、政委黎林率领下进至回龙场渡口，8 名勇士乘竹筏偷渡被巨浪吞没。2 日深夜，红军在鱼子塘等水势较缓处强渡成功，击溃北岸黔军一个营；3 日凌晨架设浮桥，至 4 日红 1 军团主力及红 9 军团渡江完毕。本坐标为回龙场渡口代表点。
description.en: On 1 January 1935 the 1st Regiment of the 1st Division, First Army Corps, under Yang Dezhi and political commissar Li Lin, reached Huilongchang Ferry; eight men on a bamboo raft were lost in the waves. Late on 2 January the Red Army crossed successfully at calmer points such as Yuzitang, routed a Guizhou battalion on the north bank, and built a pontoon bridge before dawn on 3 January; by 4 January the main force of the First Army Corps and the 9th Army Corps had crossed. The coordinate is a representative point at Huilongchang Ferry.

summary.en: The 4th Regiment forced the Wu River at Jiangjiehe, and the central column and 5th Army Corps crossed there.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月 1 日，红 1 军团第 2 师第 4 团进至江界河渡口，耿飚、杨成武侦察后决定佯攻老渡口、主攻上游新渡口。1 月 2 日，毛振华率 7 名勇士泅渡失败；夜间 18 名勇士乘竹筏偷渡，5 人潜伏北岸。3 日拂晓，60 余只竹筏在火力掩护下强渡，毛振华等 5 人从敌后接应，红军占领北岸，工兵架起浮桥，军委纵队与红 5 军团由此过江。本坐标为江界河渡口代表点。
description.en: On 1 January 1935 the 4th Regiment of the 2nd Division, First Army Corps, reached Jiangjiehe Ferry. After reconnaissance, Geng Biao and Yang Chengwu decided to feint at the old ferry and attack the upper new ferry. On 2 January Mao Zhenhua led seven men in a failed swim; that night eighteen men crossed by bamboo raft, with five hiding on the north bank. At dawn on 3 January more than sixty rafts crossed under fire while Mao and his five men attacked from the rear, seizing the north bank. Engineers built a pontoon bridge, and the CMC column and 5th Army Corps crossed there. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiangjiehe Ferry.

summary.en: The Third Army Corps crossed at Chashanguan; the defenders fled without a fight.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月 3 日，红 3 军团第 4 师第 10 团进至茶山关渡口，守敌刘翰吾部在得知回龙场、江界河失守后连夜弃阵逃回遵义。红军在当地船工协助下捞起沉船、架设浮桥，1 月 4 日至 6 日红 3 军团分别从桃子台、茶山关、楠木渡渡过乌江，进入遵义尚嵇一带。本坐标为茶山关渡口代表点。
description.en: On 3 January 1935 the 10th Regiment of the 4th Division, Third Army Corps, reached Chashanguan Ferry. After learning that Huilongchang and Jiangjiehe had fallen, Liu Hanwu’s defenders abandoned their positions and fled to Zunyi. With local boatmen the Red Army raised sunken boats and built a pontoon bridge; from 4 to 6 January the Third Army Corps crossed at Taozitai, Chashanguan, and Nanmudu and entered the Shangji area of Zunyi. The coordinate is a representative point at Chashanguan Ferry.

summary.en: Establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army; a turning point of the Long March.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月 15 日至 17 日，中共中央政治局扩大会议在遵义召开，总结第五次反“围剿”失败和长征初期失利的教训，实际确立了毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位。
description.en: From January 15 to 17, 1935, an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau was held at Zunyi. It reviewed the failures of the fifth counter-encirclement campaign and the early Long March, and effectively established Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army.

place.zh: 贵州习水土城渡口（浑溪口）

summary.zh: 红军从土城、元厚西渡赤水河，进入川南。
summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Tucheng and Yuanhou and enters southern Sichuan.

description.zh: 1935 年 1 月 28 日土城青杠坡战斗失利后，中革军委决定放弃在赤水—泸州间北渡长江的计划，改从土城、元厚西渡赤水河。29 日拂晓，红军从土城浑溪口、蔡家沱和元厚沙沱、川祖庙等渡口渡过赤水河，进入四川古蔺、叙永地区，随后转进云南扎西集结。
description.en: After the setback at Qinggangpo on 28 January 1935, the Central Revolutionary Military Commission abandoned the plan to cross the Yangtze near Chishui–Luzhou and ordered a westward crossing at Tucheng and Yuanhou. At dawn on 29 January, the Red Army crossed at Hunxikou and Caijiatuo near Tucheng and at Shatuo and Chuanzumiao near Yuanhou, entered Gulin and Xuyong in Sichuan, and then moved to Zhaxi in Yunnan.

summary.zh: 中央政治局在威信水田寨、大河滩、扎西镇连续开会，完成遵义会议未及完成的任务。
summary.en: The Politburo met successively at Shuitianzhai, Dahetan, and Zhaxi in Weixin, completing tasks left unfinished at Zunyi.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 5 日至 9 日，中央政治局在云南威信水田寨花房子、大河滩庄子上、扎西镇江西会馆连续召开会议，统称扎西会议。会议决定由张闻天代替博古负总责，毛泽东为周恩来军事指挥上的帮助者；通过《遵义会议决议》；决定暂缓北渡长江、回师东进、二渡赤水；缩编中央红军为 16 个团（加干部团 17 个团）；成立中共川南特委和红军川南游击纵队。本坐标为扎西镇代表点，水田寨、大河滩会址待分别落位。
description.en: From 5 to 9 February 1935, the Politburo met successively at the Huafangzi in Shuitianzhai, the Zhuangzishang in Dahetan, and the Jiangxi Guild Hall in Zhaxi, Weixin, Yunnan; the meetings are collectively known as the Zhaxi Meeting. They decided that Zhang Wentian should replace Bo Gu as overall leader and that Mao Zedong should assist Zhou Enlai in military command; adopted the Zunyi Conference Resolution; decided to postpone the Yangtze crossing, return east, and cross the Chishui River a second time; reduced the Central Red Army to 16 regiments (17 with the Cadre Regiment); and established the South Sichuan Special Committee and the Red Army South Sichuan Guerrilla Column. The coordinate is a representative point at Zhaxi; the Shuitianzhai and Dahetan sites await separate placement.

summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River eastward at Taipingdu, Jiuxikou, Erlangtan, and Lintan and returns to northern Guizhou.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 18 日至 21 日，中央红军分路从太平渡、九溪口、老鸹沱、二郎滩、淋滩等渡口东渡赤水河，重入黔北，随后攻占桐梓、娄山关，再占遵义。太平渡是渡口群，包含太平渡口、上游约 5 公里的九溪口和下游约 1 里的老鸹沱（老鹰石）。
description.en: From 18 to 21 February 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Chishui River eastward in several columns at Taipingdu, Jiuxikou, Laoguatuo, Erlangtan, and Lintan, re-entered northern Guizhou, captured Tongzi and Loushan Pass, and retook Zunyi. Taipingdu was a ferry group that included Taipingdu proper, Jiuxikou about 5 km upstream, and Laoguatuo (Laoyingshi) about 0.5 km downstream.

The two banks belong to Gulin, Sichuan and Xishui, Guizhou respectively, and sources differ on administrative attribution; this coordinate is approximate.

The Erlangtan Ferry is a nationally protected cultural relic.

place.en: Zunyi old city, Guizhou (the campaign spanned Tongzi, Loushan Pass, Zunyi, and Zhongzhuangpu)

summary.zh: 中央红军二渡赤水后五日之内连下桐梓、娄山关、遵义，击溃和歼灭国民党军两个师又八个团。
summary.en: After the second crossing of the Chishui River, the Central Red Army took Tongzi, Loushan Pass, and Zunyi within five days, routing two divisions and eight regiments of KMT forces.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 24 日至 3 月 1 日，中央红军二渡赤水后回师黔北，先取桐梓，再夺娄山关，27 日夜至 28 日晨重占遵义，随后在城南红花岗、老鸦山一带击退吴奇伟纵队反扑，并乘胜追至乌江边。此役击溃和歼灭国民党军两个师又八个团，毙伤约 2400 人，俘约 3000 人，是长征以来最大的一次胜利。多数战史记为 2 月 24 日至 28 日；本条目延至 3 月 1 日，以涵盖乌江边追击阶段。桐梓、娄山关、遵义城、红花岗、老鸦山、忠庄铺等地分列独立事件。
description.en: From 24 February to 1 March 1935, after crossing the Chishui River a second time, the Central Red Army returned to northern Guizhou. It took Tongzi, seized Loushan Pass, retook Zunyi on the night of 27–28 February, then repulsed Wu Qiwei’s counterattack at Honghuagang and Laoyashan south of the city and pursued the enemy to the Wu River. The campaign routed two divisions and eight regiments, with about 2,400 enemy killed or wounded and 3,000 captured, the largest victory since the Long March began. Most accounts date it 24–28 February; this entry extends to 1 March to include the pursuit to the Wu River. Tongzi, Loushan Pass, Zunyi, Honghuagang, Laoyashan, and Zhongzhuangpu are separate events.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 24 日，红一军团先头团进占桐梓县城，守敌退守娄山关。桐梓是遵义以北的门户，红军攻占桐梓后随即向娄山关发起进攻。本坐标为桐梓县城代表点，具体攻城街巷与阵地待考。
description.en: On 24 February 1935, the leading regiment of the First Army Corps entered Tongzi county town. The defenders withdrew to Loushan Pass. Tongzi was the gateway north of Zunyi; after taking it, the Red Army immediately attacked Loushan Pass. The coordinate is a representative point for the county town; the exact streets and positions of the assault await verification.

place.zh: 贵州桐梓、遵义交界（娄山关）
place.en: Loushan Pass on the Tongzi–Zunyi border, Guizhou

summary.zh: 红军在娄山关击溃黔军，取得长征以来首次大捷，为再占遵义打开通道。
summary.en: The Red Army routed Guizhou troops at Loushan Pass, its first major victory of the Long March, opening the way to retake Zunyi.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 25 日至 26 日，红一、红三军团在彭德怀、杨尚昆统一指挥下进攻娄山关，歼灭和击溃黔军四个团，26 日占领关口，并乘胜向遵义追击。娄山关位于桐梓、遵义交界的川黔古道上，是遵义以北的天然屏障。此役是遵义战役的前奏；部分资料将攻占娄山关记在 25 日晚，本条目按 25 日至 26 日处理。
description.en: From 25 to 26 February 1935, the First and Third Army Corps, under Peng Dehuai and Yang Shangkun, attacked Loushan Pass, routing four Guizhou regiments. The pass fell on 26 February and the Red Army pursued toward Zunyi. Loushan Pass lies on the old Sichuan–Guizhou road on the Tongzi–Zunyi border and was the natural barrier north of Zunyi. The battle was the prelude to the Zunyi campaign. Some accounts date the capture to the evening of 25 February; this entry treats it as 25–26 February.

summary.zh: 红三军团参谋长邓萍在遵义老城北门外侦察时中弹牺牲，年仅 27 岁。
summary.en: Deng Ping, chief of staff of the Third Army Corps, was killed by a bullet while reconnoitering outside the north gate of Zunyi’s old city. He was 27.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 27 日黄昏，红三军团参谋长邓萍率红十一团政委张爱萍、团参谋长兰国清，在遵义老城北门外拱安关斜对面、湘江东岸土埂侦察敌情时，被城内守军冷枪击中头部牺牲，年仅 27 岁，是中央红军长征中牺牲的职务最高的将领。彭德怀随后下令“拿下遵义城，为参谋长报仇”，28 日晨红军攻占遵义老城。牺牲日期另有 2 月 26 日说，本条目从 27 日说。
description.en: At dusk on 27 February 1935, Deng Ping, chief of staff of the Third Army Corps, went with Zhang Aiping, political commissar of the 11th Regiment, and the regiment’s chief of staff Lan Guoqing to reconnoiter outside the north gate of Zunyi’s old city, on the east bank of the Xiang River opposite Gong’an Pass. A shot from the defenders struck him in the head and killed him. He was 27 and was the most senior Red Army commander to die during the Long March. Peng Dehuai ordered that Zunyi be taken in revenge, and the old city fell at dawn on 28 February. Some accounts give 26 February as the date of death; this entry follows 27 February.

place.zh: 贵州遵义城南红花岗（兰家堡垭口一带）
place.en: Honghuagang south of Zunyi, Guizhou (Lanjiabao pass area)

summary.zh: 红十一团坚守红花岗，打退吴奇伟部多次进攻。
summary.en: The 11th Regiment held Honghuagang and repulsed repeated attacks by Wu Qiwei’s forces.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 28 日上午，吴奇伟纵队以第五十九师、第九十三师及黔军残部反攻遵义，首先猛攻红花岗南坡和兰家堡垭口。红十一团在团长邓国清、政委张爱萍指挥下居高临下，打退敌军多次冲锋，守住阵地。敌军转攻老鸦山后，红花岗仍是红军城南防线的重要支点。本坐标为红花岗山脊代表点，海拔约 1002 米，具体战壕与阵地待实测。
description.en: On the morning of 28 February 1935, Wu Qiwei’s column, with the 59th and 93rd Divisions and remnants of Wang Jialie’s Guizhou troops, counterattacked Zunyi and first struck the southern slope of Honghuagang and the Lanjiabao pass. The 11th Regiment, under regimental commander Deng Guoqing and political commissar Zhang Aiping, held the high ground and repulsed repeated charges. After the enemy shifted its main effort to Laoyashan, Honghuagang remained a key anchor of the Red Army’s southern defense line. The coordinate is a representative point on the Honghuagang ridge at about 1,002 m; the trenches and positions await field verification.

place.zh: 贵州遵义城西南老鸦山（土地坝垭口一带）
place.en: Laoyashan southwest of Zunyi, Guizhou (Tudiba pass area)

summary.zh: 红十团与敌反复争夺老鸦山主峰，干部团增援后夺回阵地。
summary.en: The 10th Regiment fought back and forth for the Laoyashan summit; the Cadre Regiment counterattacked and retook it.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 28 日，吴奇伟部第五十九师在飞机大炮掩护下转攻老鸦山和土地坝垭口。红十团团长张宗逊、政委黄克诚率部顽强抗击，主峰一度失守，张宗逊重伤，团参谋长钟伟剑牺牲。红十三团一部投入反击；黄昏时分，陈赓、宋任穷率军委干部团从侧翼助攻，红军夺回老鸦山主峰，并全线击溃敌军。本坐标为老鸦山主峰附近代表点，海拔约 1053 米，具体战壕与文保碑位置待实测。
description.en: On 28 February 1935, the 59th Division of Wu Qiwei’s column, supported by aircraft and artillery, shifted its attack to Laoyashan and the Tudiba pass. The 10th Regiment under Zhang Zongsun and political commissar Huang Kecheng resisted stubbornly; the summit was lost for a time, Zhang was seriously wounded, and the regiment’s chief of staff Zhong Weijian was killed. Part of the 13th Regiment joined the counterattack, and at dusk Chen Geng and Song Renqiong led the Central Military Commission Cadre Regiment in a flank attack that retook the summit and routed the enemy along the whole line. The coordinate is a representative point near the summit at about 1,053 m; the trenches and the heritage marker await field verification.

summary.zh: 红一军团主力直插吴奇伟纵队指挥部，敌军全线溃退。
summary.en: The main force of the First Army Corps drove at Wu Qiwei’s column headquarters, precipitating a general collapse.

description.zh: 1935 年 2 月 28 日，当红军在红花岗、老鸦山与敌激战时，红一军团主力从水师坝地区向敌侧后出击，直插忠庄铺吴奇伟纵队指挥部。吴奇伟仓皇南逃，率残部过乌江后砍断浮桥，滞留在北岸的约 1800 名敌军被红军俘获。忠庄铺战斗打乱了敌军指挥，是遵义战役转入追击的关键一击。本坐标为忠庄街道代表点，指挥部具体位置待考。
description.en: On 28 February 1935, while the Red Army was fighting at Honghuagang and Laoyashan, the main force of the First Army Corps struck from the Shuishiba area toward the enemy’s flank and rear, driving straight at Wu Qiwei’s column headquarters at Zhongzhuangpu. Wu fled south in haste; after crossing the Wu River with his remaining troops he cut the pontoon bridge, leaving about 1,800 men on the north bank to be captured. The action disrupted the enemy command and marked the turn from defense to pursuit in the Zunyi campaign. The coordinate is a representative point in Zhongzhuang; the exact headquarters site awaits verification.

place.zh: 贵州遵义枫香镇苟坝村

summary.zh: 中央在苟坝召开会议，撤销进攻打鼓新场计划，成立新三人团。
summary.en: The central leadership met at Gouba, cancelled the attack on Daguxinchang, and formed the new three-man military group.

description.zh: 1935 年 3 月 10 日至 12 日，中央政治局在遵义苟坝召开扩大会议，讨论是否进攻打鼓新场。毛泽东力主不打，会议一度表决撤销其前敌司令部政委职务；毛泽东当夜提马灯找周恩来、朱德，说服暂缓发令。11 日会议决定撤销进攻计划；12 日决定成立由毛泽东、周恩来、王稼祥组成的新三人团，全权指挥军事。本坐标为苟坝村代表点，会议会址与周恩来、朱德旧居待分别落位。
description.en: From 10 to 12 March 1935, the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Gouba in Zunyi to discuss whether to attack Daguxinchang. Mao Zedong opposed the attack; the meeting at one point voted to remove him as political commissar of the front command. That night Mao walked with a lantern to Zhou Enlai and Zhu De and persuaded them to delay the order. On 11 March the meeting cancelled the attack; on 12 March it decided to form a new three-man group of Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, and Wang Jiaxiang with full authority over military operations. The coordinate is a representative point at Gouba; the meeting site and the former residences of Zhou Enlai and Zhu De await separate placement.

place.zh: 贵州仁怀鲁班场（今鲁班街道黄家田村白家坳一带）
place.en: Lubanchang, Renhuai, Guizhou (Baijia’ao area, Huangjiatian Village, Luban Subdistrict)

summary.zh: 红军强攻周浑元纵队鲁班场阵地未克，随后转兵茅台三渡赤水。
summary.en: The Red Army’s assault on Zhou Hunyuan’s positions at Lubanchang failed to break through, and it turned toward Maotai for the third crossing of the Chishui.

description.zh: 1935 年 3 月 15 日，红一、红三、红五军团及军委干部团向据守仁怀鲁班场的国民党军周浑元纵队三个师发起进攻。敌军依托白家坳、团标寺、凉水井、老坑嘴、白果寺、丁家山、羊角岭一带的碉堡工事顽抗，并有飞机助战，红军多路进攻未能突破。战至当晚，红军主动撤出战斗，向茅台方向转移，16 日至 17 日由茅台三渡赤水。此役红军伤亡 489 人，歼敌 400 余人；虽未攻克鲁班场，但为三渡赤水争取了主动。本坐标为鲁班场/白家坳代表点，战场范围较大，具体阵地待实测。
description.en: On 15 March 1935, the First, Third, and Fifth Army Corps and the Central Military Commission Cadre Regiment attacked three divisions of Zhou Hunyuan’s column at Lubanchang in Renhuai. The defenders held firm in fortified positions around Baijia’ao, Tuanbiaosi, Liangshuijing, Laokengzui, Baiguosi, Dingjiashan, and Yangjiaoling, supported by aircraft, and the Red Army’s multiple attacks failed to break through. That evening the Red Army withdrew toward Maotai and crossed the Chishui River for the third time on 16–17 March. The Red Army suffered 489 casualties and killed or wounded more than 400 enemy soldiers. Although Lubanchang was not taken, the battle gained the initiative for the third crossing. The coordinate is a representative point for Lubanchang/Baijia’ao; the battlefield is extensive and the exact positions await field verification.

name.en: Third crossing of the Chishui River

place.zh: 贵州仁怀茅台渡口（中渡口、下渡口、银滩）

summary.zh: 红军在茅台中渡口、下渡口、银滩西渡赤水河，佯动调动敌军。
summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Maotai’s middle, lower, and Yintan ferries, feinting to draw off enemy forces.

description.zh: 1935 年 3 月 16 日至 17 日，中央红军在贵州仁怀茅台镇中渡口、下渡口及银滩搭设三座浮桥，西渡赤水河，再次进入川南，作出北渡长江姿态，诱使国民党军西调。下渡口西岸朱砂堡现立茅台渡口纪念碑。
description.en: From 16 to 17 March 1935, the Central Red Army built three pontoon bridges at Maotai’s middle ferry, lower ferry, and Yintan, crossed the Chishui River westward, re-entered southern Sichuan, and feinted a Yangtze crossing to draw Kuomintang forces west. The Maotai Ferry Monument now stands at Zhushabao on the west bank of the lower ferry.

place.zh: 四川古蔺太平渡（含九溪口、二郎滩、淋滩）

summary.zh: 红军由二郎滩、太平渡、九溪口、淋滩东渡赤水河，摆脱围追堵截。
summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River eastward at Erlangtan, Taipingdu, Jiuxikou, and Lintan, escaping encirclement.

description.zh: 1935 年 3 月 21 日至 22 日，中央红军主力分路从二郎滩、太平渡、九溪口、淋滩等渡口秘密东渡赤水河，把敌军甩在赤水河西岸，随后南渡乌江、佯攻贵阳、西进云南。各军团具体渡口在不同史料中记载略有差异，本条目只列主要渡口，不把军团分配写成唯一结论。
description.en: From 21 to 22 March 1935, the main force of the Central Red Army secretly crossed the Chishui River eastward in several columns at Erlangtan, Taipingdu, Jiuxikou, and Lintan, leaving enemy forces on the west bank; it then crossed the Wu River southward, feinted toward Guiyang, and moved west into Yunnan. Sources differ slightly on which corps used which ferry, so this entry lists the main ferries without asserting a single corps-to-ferry assignment.

aliases.en: The Fourth Front Army Begins the Long March

summary.zh: 红四方面军强渡嘉陵江，策应中央红军，开始长征。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army forced the Jialing River to support the Central Red Army and began its Long March.

description.zh: 1935 年 3 月 28 日至 4 月 21 日，红四方面军为策应中央红军、向川甘边界发展，在苍溪、阆中间强渡嘉陵江。红 30 军从塔子山主渡，红 31 军从鸳溪口、红 9 军从涧溪口渡江，红 4 军为第二梯队。渡江后攻占剑门关、昭化、南部、剑阁、梓潼、江油、中坝、青川、平武、北川等地，歼敌 1 万余人，控制嘉陵江与涪江之间广大地区。从强渡嘉陵江起，红四方面军实际上开始长征。本坐标为苍溪塔子山渡口代表点。
description.en: From 28 March to 21 April 1935, the Fourth Front Army forced the Jialing River between Cangxi and Langzhong to support the Central Red Army and expand toward the Sichuan–Gansu border. The 30th Army crossed at the Tazishan main crossing, the 31st Army at Yuanxikou, and the 9th Army at Jianxikou, with the 4th Army as the second echelon. After crossing, the Red Army took Jianmen Pass, Zhaohua, Nanbu, Jiange, Zitong, Jiangyou, Zhongba, Qingchuan, Pingwu, and Beichuan, destroyed more than 10,000 enemy troops, and controlled the area between the Jialing and Fu rivers. From this crossing, the Fourth Front Army effectively began its Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at the Tazishan ferry in Cangxi.

summary.zh: 中央红军从江口、大塘、梯子岩南渡乌江，跳出乌江以北包围圈。
summary.en: The Central Red Army crossed the Wu River southward at Jiangkou, Datang, and Tiziyan, escaping the encirclement north of the river.

description.zh: 1935 年 3 月 29 日，红一军团先遣部队进至金沙后山乌江边，红三团袭击江口、大塘、梯子岩渡口，工兵连夜架设浮桥。30 日至 31 日，红一、红三军团及军委纵队先后渡江；4 月 1 日红五军团渡江完毕，中央红军主力全部进入息烽境内。南渡乌江为四渡赤水画上句号，把国民党军主力甩在乌江以北。本坐标为后山渡口群代表点，三个渡口待分别落位。
description.en: On 29 March 1935, the advance guard of the First Army Corps reached the Wu River at Houshan, Jinsha. The Third Regiment attacked the Jiangkou, Datang, and Tiziyan ferries, and engineers built pontoon bridges overnight. On 30–31 March the First and Third Army Corps and the CMC column crossed; the Fifth Army Corps finished on 1 April, and the main force entered Xifeng county. The crossing closed the Four Crossings of the Chishui campaign and left the main KMT forces north of the Wu River. The coordinate is a representative point for the Houshan ferry group; the three ferries await separate placement.

summary.en: The Red Army threatened Guiyang and feinted at Longli, drawing out the Yunnan army and opening the route west into Yunnan.

description.zh: 1935 年 4 月 2 日，中央红军以一部佯攻息烽，主力进至扎佐、狗场，前锋逼近贵阳。蒋介石急调滇军孙渡纵队星夜赴贵阳“保驾”，并将各路敌军向贵阳以东集中。4 月 5 日，红军又在清水江架桥作东渡姿态，进一步迷惑敌军。4 月 8 日至 9 日，红军从贵阳、龙里间狭窄地段穿过湘黔公路，向西进入云南。本坐标为贵阳附近代表点，具体佯攻阵地待考。
description.en: On 2 April 1935, part of the Central Red Army feinted at Xifeng while the main force reached Zhazuo and Gaochang, with its advance guard approaching Guiyang. Chiang Kai-shek urgently summoned Sun Du’s Yunnan column to defend Guiyang and concentrated other forces east of the city. On 5 April the Red Army built bridges over the Qingshui River to suggest an eastward crossing, further misleading the enemy. On 8–9 April it passed through the narrow gap between Guiyang and Longli, crossed the Hunan–Guizhou highway, and moved west into Yunnan. The coordinate is a representative point near Guiyang; the exact feint positions await verification.

place.en: Jiaopingdu, Luquan, Yunnan (representative point of the Jinsha River blockade)

summary.zh: 国民党滇军、川军沿金沙江设防，企图阻止红军北上。
summary.en: Yunnan and Sichuan KMT forces defended the Jinsha River to block the Red Army’s move north.

description.zh: 1935 年 4 月至 5 月，蒋介石命云南省政府主席龙云收缴沿江船只、封锁渡口，滇军孙渡纵队等部尾追；川康边防军刘元瑭部等防守金沙江北岸与通安、会理。红军以龙街渡、洪门渡佯动牵制敌军，主力从皎平渡渡江，并在石板河击退追兵，突破金沙江封锁。本坐标为皎平渡代表点，防线沿金沙江展开。
description.en: From April to May 1935, Chiang Kai-shek ordered Yunnan governor Long Yun to collect boats and blockade the river; Sun Du’s Yunnan troops pursued, while Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan border troops defended the north bank, Tongan, and Huili. The Red Army feinted at Longjie and Hongmen, crossed the main force at Jiaopingdu, and halted the pursuers at Shibanhe, breaking the Jinsha River blockade. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiaopingdu; the line extended along the Jinsha River.

summary.en: Sichuan troops under Liu Xiang, Liu Wenhui and Deng Xihou blocked the Red Fourth Front Army to prevent it from joining the Central Red Army.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月至 1936 年 10 月，川军刘湘、刘文辉、邓锡侯等部在川陕甘边对红四方面军进行堵截与追击，红军在川西北与甘孜地区与国民党军周旋，最终北上会宁。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From May 1935 to October 1936, Sichuan troops under Liu Xiang, Liu Wenhui and Deng Xihou blocked and pursued the Red Fourth Front Army along the Sichuan-Shaanxi-Gansu border; the Red Army maneuvered in northwestern Sichuan and the Garzê region before marching north to Huining. summary.zh: 中央红军主力从皎平渡巧渡金沙江，跳出数十万敌军围堵。
summary.en: The main force of the Central Red Army crossed the Jinsha River at Jiaopingdu, escaping the encirclement of hundreds of thousands of KMT troops.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日至 9 日，中央红军主力在皎平渡，以 6 条木船、37 名船工，历时 7 天 7 夜渡过金沙江。此前红一、红三军团分别在龙街渡、洪门渡受阻，先后转至皎平渡；红五军团在石板河阻击追敌，红九军团从树桔渡过江。至 5 月 9 日，中央红军 3 万余人全部过江，粉碎了蒋介石围歼红军于川黔滇边境的计划。本坐标为皎平渡渡口代表点。
description.en: From 3 to 9 May 1935, the main force of the Central Red Army crossed the Jinsha River at Jiaopingdu with six boats and 37 boatmen over seven days and nights. The First and Third Army Corps had been blocked at Longjie and Hongmen and shifted to Jiaopingdu; the Fifth Army Corps blocked the pursuers at Shibanhe, and the Ninth Army Corps crossed at Shuju. By 9 May more than 30,000 troops had crossed, foiling Chiang Kai-shek’s plan to destroy the Red Army on the Sichuan–Guizhou–Yunnan border. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiaopingdu.

place.zh: 云南禄劝皎平渡（战役范围含龙街、洪门、树桔渡）
place.en: Jiaopingdu, Luquan, Yunnan (the campaign spanned Longjie, Hongmen, and Shuju ferries)

summary.zh: 中央红军分三路抢渡金沙江，主力从皎平渡过江，跳出数十万敌军围堵。
summary.en: The Central Red Army crossed the Jinsha River in three columns, with the main force crossing at Jiaopingdu and escaping the encirclement of hundreds of thousands of KMT troops.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日至 9 日，中央红军分三路抢渡金沙江：红一军团攻龙街渡，红三军团攻洪门渡，军委纵队和红五军团抢占皎平渡；红九军团从树桔渡渡江。龙街、洪门两渡因江宽流急、船只缺乏未能架桥，红一、红三军团主力先后转至皎平渡。至 5 月 9 日，中央红军主力 3 万余人从皎平渡全部过江，粉碎了蒋介石围歼红军于川黔滇边境的计划。皎平渡、龙街渡、洪门渡、树桔渡、石板河阻击战、通安战斗分列独立事件。
description.en: From 3 to 9 May 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Jinsha River in three columns: the First Army Corps moved on Longjie Ferry, the Third Army Corps on Hongmen Ferry, and the Central Military Commission column with the Fifth Army Corps seized Jiaopingdu; the Ninth Army Corps crossed at Shuju Ferry. Longjie and Hongmen could not be bridged because of the wide, swift river and lack of boats, and the main forces of the First and Third Corps shifted to Jiaopingdu. By 9 May more than 30,000 troops had crossed at Jiaopingdu, foiling Chiang Kai-shek’s plan to destroy the Red Army on the Sichuan–Guizhou–Yunnan border. Jiaopingdu, Longjie, Hongmen, Shuju, the Shibanhe blocking battle, and the Tongan battle are separate events.

summary.zh: 皎平渡是中央红军主力渡金沙江的主渡口，6 条木船、37 名船工昼夜摆渡 7 天 7 夜。
summary.en: Jiaopingdu was the main crossing of the Jinsha River for the Central Red Army, where six boats and 37 boatmen ferried troops for seven days and nights.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日黄昏，刘伯承率军委干部团先遣队抢占皎平渡南岸，夺得木船 2 只，夜渡控制北岸中武山渡口。随后红军又找到 4 只船，共 6 只，并动员 37 名船工，在刘伯承、陈云分任司令员、政委的渡江指挥部统一调度下，按《渡江守则》编队编号、昼夜摆渡。至 5 月 9 日，中央红军主力 3 万余人全部由此过江。本坐标为皎平渡渡口代表点，南岸起渡点与北岸红军洞待实测。
description.en: At dusk on 3 May 1935, Liu Bocheng led the advance detachment of the Central Military Commission Cadre Regiment to seize the south bank at Jiaopingdu, captured two boats, and crossed at night to control the Zhongwushan landing on the north bank. The Red Army found four more boats, six in total, and mobilized 37 boatmen. Under the crossing command headed by Liu Bocheng and Chen Yun, and the “Crossing Rules”, the boats were numbered and ferried day and night. By 9 May more than 30,000 troops of the main force had crossed. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiaopingdu; the south-bank launching point and the north-bank Red Army cave await verification.

summary.en: The First Army Corps failed to cross at Longjie Ferry, but its feint pinned enemy forces before it shifted to Jiaopingdu.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日，红一军团先头部队到达元谋龙街渡，渡船已被敌军毁坏；红军在花石滩架设浮桥，因江宽流急、敌机轰炸未成。红军以少量部队继续架桥佯渡，吸引国民党军主力向元谋方向集中，掩护主力从皎平渡渡江。5 月 5 日，红一军团奉命顺江而下，转赴皎平渡。本坐标为龙街渡代表点。
description.en: On 3 May 1935, the advance guard of the First Army Corps reached Longjie Ferry in Yuanmou, but the enemy had destroyed the boats. An attempt to build a pontoon bridge at Huashitan failed because of the wide, swift river and enemy air attacks. A small force continued the bridge feint, drawing KMT forces toward Yuanmou and covering the main crossing at Jiaopingdu. On 5 May the First Army Corps was ordered downstream to Jiaopingdu. The coordinate is a representative point at Longjie Ferry.

summary.en: The Fifth Army Corps blocked KMT forces at Shibanhe for seven days and nights, covering the main force’s crossing.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日，红五军团奉命在禄劝石板河一线构筑阵地，阻击尾追的国民党军万耀煌第 13 师等部，掩护中央纵队从皎平渡渡江。红军依托小庙垭口等险要地形，坚守 7 昼夜，打退敌军多次进攻；5 月 9 日完成掩护任务后，撤出阵地，急行军至皎平渡过江。本坐标为石板河/小庙垭口代表点，具体战壕与阵地待实测。
description.en: On 3 May 1935, the Fifth Army Corps was ordered to build positions at Shibanhe in Luquan to block the pursuing KMT 13th Division under Wan Yaohuang and cover the central column’s crossing at Jiaopingdu. Holding strong points such as the Xiaomiao pass, the corps resisted for seven days and nights and repulsed repeated attacks. On 9 May, after completing the mission, it withdrew and marched rapidly to Jiaopingdu to cross. The coordinate is a representative point at Shibanhe/Xiaomiao pass; the trenches and positions await verification.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日至 4 日，军委干部团在陈赓、宋任穷率领下渡过金沙江，向通安推进，击溃川军刘元瑭部，占领通安镇，保障了皎平渡渡口北岸的安全。通安是皎平渡通往会理的要道。本坐标为通安镇代表点，具体战斗阵地待考。
description.en: On 3–4 May 1935, the CMC Cadre Regiment under Chen Geng and Song Renqiong crossed the Jinsha River and advanced on Tongan, routing Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops and seizing the town, securing the north bank at Jiaopingdu. Tongan was the key route from Jiaopingdu to Huili. The coordinate is a representative point for Tongan; the exact positions await verification.

summary.zh: 红三军团在洪门渡架桥未成，仅红十三团由一只木船渡过，主力转赴皎平渡。
summary.en: The Third Army Corps failed to bridge the Hongmen Ferry; only the 13th Regiment crossed by a single boat, and the main force shifted to Jiaopingdu.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 3 日，红三军团先头部队到达禄劝洪门渡，江面不宽但水流湍急，架设浮桥被冲毁。红军找到一只小木船，在船工帮助下昼夜摆渡，仅红十三团渡过金沙江，占领北岸可河街。5 月 5 日，红三军团主力奉命逆江而上，转赴皎平渡。本坐标为洪门渡/可河渡口代表点。
description.en: On 3 May 1935, the advance guard of the Third Army Corps reached Hongmen Ferry in Luquan. The river was narrow but swift, and the pontoon bridge was swept away. The Red Army found a small boat and, with local boatmen, ferried the 13th Regiment across to seize Kehe Street on the north bank. On 5 May the main force was ordered upstream to Jiaopingdu. The coordinate is a representative point at the Hongmen/Kehe ferry.

summary.zh: 红九军团从树桔渡渡过金沙江，完成侧翼牵制任务。
summary.en: The Ninth Army Corps crossed the Jinsha River at Shuju Ferry, completing its flanking and diversion task.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 4 日，红九军团先头部队到达东川树桔渡，在船工帮助下打捞修补一只沉船，连夜摆渡 13 次，将 200 余人送过江。随后红军夺取北岸汪家坪盐场，打捞被封沉的盐船，5 月 5 日至 6 日全军团 3400 余人由树桔渡渡过金沙江。本坐标为树桔渡代表点，渡江指挥所旧址在白鹤滩蓄水前位于树桔村田尾巴。
description.en: On 4 May 1935, the advance guard of the Ninth Army Corps reached Shuju Ferry in Dongchuan. With local boatmen they raised and repaired a sunken boat and ferried more than 200 men across in 13 trips overnight. The Red Army then seized the Wangjiaping salt works on the north bank and recovered the sunken salt boats; on 5–6 May the entire corps of more than 3,400 crossed at Shuju. The coordinate is a representative point at Shuju Ferry; the crossing command site stood at Tianweiba, Shuju Village, before the Baihetan reservoir.

summary.zh: 红军在皎平渡北岸岩洞设立渡江指挥部，统一调度全军渡江。
summary.en: The Red Army set up a crossing command in a cave on the north bank at Jiaopingdu to coordinate the crossing.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 4 日，毛泽东、朱德、周恩来等率军委纵队从皎平渡过江后，在江北岸一孔天然岩洞设立渡江指挥部，由刘伯承任司令员、陈云任政委，颁布《渡江守则》，统一调度船只、船工与各部队渡江顺序。指挥部同时处理电报、筹粮与船工保障，是皎平渡 7 天 7 夜有序渡江的中枢。本坐标为北岸红军洞代表点，原洞已在乌东德水库蓄水后淹没，现为原址附近纪念点。
description.en: After Mao Zedong, Zhu De, Zhou Enlai, and the CMC column crossed at Jiaopingdu on 4 May 1935, they established a crossing command in a natural cave on the north bank. Liu Bocheng served as commander and Chen Yun as political commissar; the command issued the “Crossing Rules” and coordinated boats, boatmen, and the crossing order of each unit. It also handled telegrams, grain, and boatmen’s support, forming the hub of the seven-day crossing. The coordinate is a representative point at the north-bank Red Army cave; the original cave was submerged by the Wudongde reservoir, and a memorial now stands nearby.

summary.zh: 红三军团围攻会理城 7 天 7 夜，未克后撤围北上。
summary.en: The Third Army Corps besieged Huili for seven days and nights before withdrawing and moving north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 8 日，红三军团到达会理城郊，夺取城东东山寺、城西南西来寺等制高点，包围会理城；9 日，军委干部团加入攻城。红军主攻北、西两面，连续攻城并挖掘坑道，14 日以棺材装火药炸开西北角城墙，守军刘元瑭部堵住缺口，红军攻城未克。7 天 7 夜后，中革军委决定停止攻城，撤围北上。本坐标为会理古城代表点，具体攻城阵地待考。
description.en: On 8 May 1935, the Third Army Corps reached the outskirts of Huili, seized the Dongshan and Xilai temples and other high ground, and encircled the city; on 9 May the CMC Cadre Regiment joined the assault. The Red Army attacked the north and west sides, dug tunnels, and on 14 May blew a breach in the northwest wall with gunpowder packed in a coffin, but Liu Yuantang’s defenders sealed it. After seven days and nights, the CMC ordered the siege lifted and the army moved north. The coordinate is a representative point for Huili old city; the exact assault positions await verification.

summary.zh: 川军刘元瑭部死守会理，烧毁城外民房、封闭城门，红军攻城未克。
summary.en: Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops held Huili, burning houses outside the walls and sealing the gates; the Red Army failed to take the city.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月，川军刘元瑭部（第 7 师等）防守会理城。守军为清除射界，用煤油、棉花烧毁城外北关、西关、东关民房，封闭四门，撬起街石堵塞城门，并强迫军警死守。红三军团与军委干部团围攻 7 天 7 夜，爆破西北角城墙后，刘元瑭亲自率部堵击，面部受伤，仍堵住缺口。红军撤围后，守军仍固守会理。本坐标为会理古城代表点，具体城防工事待考。
description.en: In May 1935, Liu Yuantang’s Sichuan troops (including the 7th Division) defended Huili. To clear fields of fire, they burned houses in the north, west, and east suburbs with kerosene and cotton, sealed the four gates, pried up street stones to block the gateways, and ordered the garrison to hold to the death. The Third Army Corps and the CMC Cadre Regiment besieged the city for seven days and nights; after the northwest wall was breached, Liu Yuantang personally led the counterattack, was wounded in the face, and sealed the gap. The Red Army withdrew, and the garrison held Huili. The coordinate is a representative point for the old city; the exact defenses await verification.

summary.zh: 中央政治局在会理城北铁厂村召开扩大会议，决定继续北上、抢渡大渡河。
summary.en: The Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Tiechang Village north of Huili and decided to continue north to force the Dadu River.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 12 日，中共中央政治局在会理城北铁厂村召开扩大会议，总结遵义会议以来的战略方针，批评部分同志对机动作战的怀疑，决定继续北上、越大渡河与红四方面军会合，并任命刘伯承为先遣队司令员、聂荣臻为政委。会议先在树林草棚中举行，因敌机侦察，后转移到平安寺继续。与会人员记载略有出入，本条目只列主要人员。本坐标为铁厂村会理会议纪念地代表点。
description.en: On 12 May 1935, the CCP Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Tiechang Village north of Huili. It reviewed the strategy since the Zunyi Conference, criticized doubts about mobile warfare, decided to continue north across the Dadu River to join the Fourth Front Army, and appointed Liu Bocheng as advance detachment commander and Nie Rongzhen as political commissar. The meeting began in a makeshift shelter in the woods and moved to Ping’an Temple because of enemy air reconnaissance. Accounts of attendees differ slightly; this entry lists only the main participants. The coordinate is a representative point at the Tiechang meeting memorial site.

summary.en: At Lugu, Liu Bocheng and Nie Rongzhen decided to take the Mianning–Tuowu–Anshunchang trail and sent the Fifth Regiment to feint at Dashubao.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 20 日晚，红军先遣队在冕宁泸沽决定改变原定经越西、大树堡的大路，改走冕宁、大桥、拖乌、彝海至安顺场的小路，以避开川军重兵；同时派左权、刘亚楼率红一军团第二师第五团等向越西、大树堡方向佯动，迷惑富林之敌。21 日，中革军委复电同意。本坐标为泸沽镇代表点。
description.en: On the night of 20 May 1935, the Red Army advance detachment at Lugu in Mianning decided to abandon the main road via Yuexi and Dashubao for the trail through Mianning, Daqiao, Tuowu, and Yihai to Anshunchang, avoiding the main Sichuan forces. At the same time, Zuo Quan and Liu Yalou led the Fifth Regiment of the Second Division toward Yuexi and Dashubao as a feint to deceive the enemy at Fulin. On 21 May the CMC approved the change. The coordinate is a representative point for Lugu.

summary.zh: 红军先遣队进入冕宁，释放“换班坐质”彝族首领，随后成立冕宁县革命委员会。
summary.en: The Red Army advance detachment entered Mianning, released Yi hostages held under the rotation-hostage system, and later established the Mianning Revolutionary Committee.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 21 日凌晨，刘伯承、聂荣臻率先遣队到达冕宁县城，在地下党配合下进城，释放被扣押的彝族“换班坐质”人质，焚毁强迫签署的文书，宣布废除换班坐质制度。5 月 23 日，红军在冕宁文庙召开群众大会，成立冕宁县革命委员会，陈野苹任主席、李井泉任副主席，并成立抗捐军。本坐标为冕宁县城代表点。
description.en: In the early hours of 21 May 1935, Liu Bocheng and Nie Rongzhen led the advance detachment into Mianning county town with local underground party support. They released Yi hostages held under the rotation-hostage system, burned the forced agreements, and abolished the system. On 23 May the Red Army held a mass meeting at the Mianning Confucian temple and established the Mianning County Revolutionary Committee, with Chen Yeping as chairman and Li Jingquan as vice chairman, along with an anti-tax militia. The coordinate is a representative point for the county town.

place.zh: 四川冕宁彝海镇彝海（袁居海子）

summary.zh: 刘伯承与彝族果基家支首领小叶丹在彝海歃血为盟，红军顺利通过彝区。
summary.en: Liu Bocheng and Xiaoyedan, leader of the Yi Guji clan, swore a blood oath at Yihai, allowing the Red Army to pass through Yi territory.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 22 日，红军先遣队在冕宁以北彝海（袁居海子）与彝族果基家支首领果基约达（小叶丹）歃血为盟。因无酒，刘伯承以彝海水代酒，与小叶丹饮鸡血水结为兄弟；当晚授予小叶丹“中国夷民红军沽鸡支队”队旗，并赠送枪支。小叶丹随后派向导护送红军通过拖乌彝区，为强渡大渡河赢得时间。本坐标为彝海结盟取水点附近代表点。
description.en: On 22 May 1935, the Red Army advance detachment swore a blood oath with Xiaoyedan (Guji Yueda), leader of the Yi Guji clan, at Yihai (Yuanju Haizi) north of Mianning. With no wine, Liu Bocheng used water from Yihai and drank chicken blood with Xiaoyedan as brothers. That evening he gave Xiaoyedan the banner of the “Chinese Yi Red Army Guji Detachment” and presented rifles. Xiaoyedan then sent guides to escort the Red Army through Tuowu Yi territory, gaining time for the Dadu River crossing. The coordinate is a representative point near the oath-taking site at Yihai.

summary.zh: 红一军团第二师第五团等佯攻大树堡，牵制富林川军，掩护安顺场主渡。
summary.en: The Fifth Regiment of the Second Division and other units feinted at Dashubao, pinning Sichuan troops at Fulin and covering the main crossing at Anshunchang.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 20 日夜，红一军团参谋长左权、第二师政委刘亚楼率第二师第五团等由泸沽分兵，经越西、海棠向大树堡挺进；23 日占领大树堡，24 日至 25 日在大渡河南岸大张旗鼓造船、扎筏、架线，制造由大树堡渡河攻打富林、雅安、成都的假象。北岸川军急调兵力增援富林，放松了安顺场至泸定一线的防守。26 日红五团奉命撤离大树堡，绕道返回安顺场。本坐标为大树堡镇代表点，渡口具体位置待实测。
description.en: On the night of 20 May 1935, Zuo Quan, chief of staff of the First Army Corps, and Liu Yalou, political commissar of the Second Division, led the Fifth Regiment and other units from Lugu via Yuexi and Haitang toward Dashubao. They took Dashubao on 23 May and on 24–25 May ostentatiously built boats and rafts and laid telephone lines on the south bank, creating the impression that the main force would cross at Dashubao and drive on Fulin, Ya’an, and Chengdu. Sichuan troops rushed reinforcements to Fulin, weakening the Anshunchang–Luding sector. On 26 May the Fifth Regiment withdrew and returned to Anshunchang. The coordinate is a representative point for Dashubao; the exact ferry site awaits verification.

place.zh: 四川石棉安顺场（战役范围含大树堡、磨西、泸定桥）
place.en: Anshunchang, Shimian, Sichuan (the campaign spanned Dashubao, Moxi, and Luding Bridge)

summary.zh: 中央红军在安顺场强渡大渡河、飞夺泸定桥，粉碎川军围堵，打开北上通道。
summary.en: The Central Red Army forced the Dadu River at Anshunchang and seized Luding Bridge, breaking the Sichuan army’s blockade and opening the route north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 24 日至 29 日，中央红军先遣队夜袭安顺场，25 日十七勇士强渡大渡河；因船只不足，主力分左右两路沿大渡河两岸北上，29 日红四团夺取泸定桥，中央红军主力陆续过河。此役粉碎了蒋介石让红军成为“石达开第二”的企图，打开了北上川西的通道。战役范围含安顺场、大树堡佯动、磨西会议与泸定桥，分列独立事件。
description.en: From 24 to 29 May 1935, the Central Red Army’s advance detachment seized Anshunchang by night; on 25 May seventeen heroes forced the Dadu River. Because there were too few boats, the main force moved north along both banks, and on 29 May the Fourth Regiment seized Luding Bridge, allowing the main force to cross. The campaign foiled Chiang Kai-shek’s attempt to repeat Shi Dakai’s destruction and opened the route to western Sichuan. Anshunchang, the Dashubao feint, the Moxi meeting, and Luding Bridge are separate events.

summary.zh: 川军第二十四军一部防守安顺场北岸，未能阻止红军强渡。
summary.en: A force of the Sichuan 24th Army defended the north bank at Anshunchang but failed to stop the Red Army’s crossing.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月，川军第二十四军第五旅第七团一个营防守安顺场北岸渡口，另有“彝务指挥官”邓秀廷部两个连协同。守军收缴南岸船只、在北岸修筑碉堡，并在南岸安顺场堆积柴草准备烧街。24 日夜红军袭占安顺场，守军未能及时纵火；25 日红军十七勇士强渡，赵章成炮火摧毁北岸碉堡，守军溃退。本坐标为安顺场北岸滩头代表点，具体碉堡位置待考。
description.en: In May 1935, one battalion of the 7th Regiment, 5th Brigade, Sichuan 24th Army defended the north bank at Anshunchang, with two companies under the “Yi affairs commander” Deng Xiuting. The defenders collected boats on the south bank, built blockhouses on the north bank, and piled combustibles in Anshunchang to burn the street. The Red Army seized Anshunchang on the night of 24 May before the defenders could set fires; on 25 May the seventeen heroes crossed, Zhao Zhangcheng’s shellfire destroyed the north-bank blockhouses, and the defenders fled. The coordinate is a representative point on the north bank; the exact blockhouse sites await verification.

summary.zh: 红军十七勇士在安顺场强渡大渡河，打开北上通道。
summary.en: Seventeen heroes forced the Dadu River at Anshunchang, opening the route north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 24 日夜，红一团袭占安顺场，夺得木船一只。25 日清晨，一营营长孙继先率十七勇士分两批强渡大渡河，在赵章成炮火掩护下击溃北岸守军，占领桃子湾渡口。随后红军在安靖坝又找到两只船，77 名船工连续摆渡 7 天 7 夜，把主力送过河。安顺场由此成为长征中“翼王悲剧地、红军胜利场”的标志性渡口。本坐标为安顺场渡口代表点。
description.en: On the night of 24 May 1935, the First Regiment seized Anshunchang and captured a wooden boat. At dawn on 25 May, Sun Jixian led seventeen heroes across in two groups; covered by Zhao Zhangcheng’s artillery, they routed the north-bank defenders and took the Taozhiwan landing. Two more boats were found at Anjingba, and 77 boatmen ferried the main force for seven days and nights. Anshunchang became the emblematic crossing where the Red Army avoided Shi Dakai’s fate. The coordinate is a representative point at the ferry.

name.zh: 国民党军大渡河防线（川军）

place.zh: 四川石棉安顺场（大渡河防线代表点）
place.en: Anshunchang, Shimian, Sichuan (representative point of the Dadu River defense line)

summary.zh: 国民党川军沿大渡河设防，企图阻止红军渡河北上。
summary.en: Sichuan KMT forces defended the Dadu River to block the Red Army’s crossing.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月，国民党军以川军第二十四军刘文辉部守大渡河上游，杨森第二十军等守富林至雅安一线，重点东重西轻。第二十四军第五旅第七团一个营守安顺场北岸，第四旅第三十八团两个营守泸定城与泸定桥，另有地方民团协同。红军以大树堡佯攻牵制富林方向，主力从安顺场强渡并夺取泸定桥，突破了大渡河防线。本坐标为安顺场代表点，防线范围沿大渡河展开。
description.en: In May 1935, Liu Wenhui’s Sichuan 24th Army held the upper Dadu River while Yang Sen’s 20th Army and other units held the Fulin–Ya’an sector, with the strongest defenses in the east. One battalion of the 7th Regiment, 5th Brigade, 24th Army held the north bank at Anshunchang, and two battalions of the 38th Regiment, 4th Brigade, held Luding town and bridge, supported by local militia. The Red Army feinted at Dashubao to pin forces at Fulin, then forced the river at Anshunchang and seized Luding Bridge, breaking the defense line. The coordinate is a representative point at Anshunchang; the line extended along the Dadu River.

place.zh: 四川石棉安顺场大渡河南岸
place.en: South bank of the Dadu River at Anshunchang, Shimian, Sichuan

summary.zh: 安顺场渡口是红军强渡大渡河的主要渡口，十七勇士由此登船突击。
summary.en: Anshunchang Ferry was the main crossing point of the Dadu River, from which seventeen heroes launched their assault.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 24 日夜，红一团冒雨急行军袭占安顺场，歼灭守敌两个连，夺得翘首木船一只，控制南岸渡口。25 日清晨，一营营长孙继先率十七勇士分两批从安顺场渡口登船，在轻重机枪和迫击炮掩护下强渡；赵章成以两发炮弹摧毁北岸碉堡，勇士们占领桃子湾渡口。随后 77 名船工用 3 只木船连续摆渡 7 天 7 夜，将主力送过大渡河。渡口现存“红军渡”石碑、强渡大渡河纪念碑与指挥楼。本坐标为安顺场镇渡口代表点，具体起渡点待实测。
description.en: On the night of 24 May 1935, the First Regiment seized Anshunchang, destroyed two enemy companies, captured a wooden boat, and controlled the south bank. At dawn on 25 May, Sun Jixian, commander of the 1st Battalion, led seventeen heroes across in two groups from Anshunchang Ferry under machine-gun and mortar cover; Zhao Zhangcheng knocked out the north-bank blockhouses with two shells, and the heroes took the Taozhiwan landing. Some 77 boatmen then ferried the main force across in three boats for seven days and nights. The “Red Army Crossing” stone, the memorial, and the command tower remain. The coordinate is a representative point at Anshunchang; the exact launching point awaits verification.

summary.zh: 川军第二十四军第三十八团等防守泸定桥，抽去桥板、火烧东桥头，仍未能阻止红军夺桥。
summary.en: The 38th Regiment of the Sichuan 24th Army defended Luding Bridge, removing planks and setting fire to the east bridgehead, but failed to stop the Red Army.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 28 日，川军第二十四军第四旅第三十八团（团长李全山）第三营（营长周桂山）奉命连夜赶赴泸定，拆去泸定桥大部分桥板，在东桥头构筑机枪、迫击炮阵地，并准备煤油烧桥。29 日下午红四团发起夺桥战斗，二十二名勇士攀踏铁索冲击，守军点燃东桥头大火，红军冲过火墙，经约两小时激战占领泸定城与桥梁。本坐标为泸定桥东桥头代表点，具体阵地待实测。
description.en: On 28 May 1935, the 3rd Battalion of the 38th Regiment, 4th Brigade, Sichuan 24th Army (regimental commander Li Quanshan; battalion commander Zhou Guishan) rushed to Luding, removed most of the bridge planks, built machine-gun and mortar positions at the east bridgehead, and prepared kerosene to burn the bridge. On the afternoon of 29 May the Fourth Regiment attacked; twenty-two heroes advanced along the iron chains, the defenders set the east bridgehead ablaze, and the Red Army broke through the flames, taking Luding town and the bridge after about two hours. The coordinate is a representative point at the east bridgehead; the exact positions await verification.

summary.en: Twenty-two heroes seized Luding Bridge along its iron chains, opening the route north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 29 日，红四团在团长黄开湘（一作王开湘）、政委杨成武率领下，一昼夜急行军 240 里赶到泸定桥西桥头。下午 4 时，二连连长廖大珠率二十二名勇士攀踏被抽去桥板的十三根铁索，冒着东桥头火力冲击；守军点燃桥头大火，勇士们冲过火墙，经约两小时激战占领泸定城与桥梁。红四团伤亡 4 人，中央红军主力随后由泸定桥过大渡河。本坐标为泸定桥代表点。
description.en: On 29 May 1935, the Fourth Regiment under Huang Kaixiang (also written Wang Kaixiang) and political commissar Yang Chengwu reached the west end of Luding Bridge after a 240-li forced march in a day and night. At 4 p.m., Liao Dazhu, commander of the 2nd Company, led twenty-two heroes along the thirteen iron chains stripped of planks, under fire from the east bridgehead. The defenders set the bridgehead ablaze; the heroes charged through the flames and took Luding town and the bridge after about two hours. The Fourth Regiment suffered four casualties, and the main force crossed the Dadu River at Luding. The coordinate is a representative point at the bridge.

summary.zh: 毛泽东在磨西天主教堂召集会议，确定有序通过泸定桥与北上安排。
summary.en: Mao Zedong convened a meeting at the Moxi Catholic Church, deciding on the orderly crossing of Luding Bridge and the route north.

description.zh: 1935 年 5 月 29 日晚，毛泽东随中央军委机关抵达泸定磨西，宿营磨西天主教堂神甫楼，并召集朱德、周恩来、张闻天、王稼祥、陈云、秦邦宪等开会。会议决定红军不去康定，通知部队有序通过泸定桥、先过人后过马，派陈云出川赴上海恢复党组织并转赴苏联，同时抓紧筹粮，并准备到泸定后研究北上路线。会议日期另有 5 月 28 日说，参加人员记载亦有出入，本条目从 29 日说并只列主要与会者。5 月 30 日凌晨毛泽东离开磨西，行至摩岗岭接到红四团夺取泸定桥的捷报。
description.en: On the evening of 29 May 1935, Mao Zedong reached Moxi in Luding with the Central Military Commission office and stayed at the priest’s house of the Moxi Catholic Church. He convened Zhu De, Zhou Enlai, Zhang Wentian, Wang Jiaxiang, Chen Yun, Qin Bangxian, and others. The meeting decided not to go to Kangding; to move troops across Luding Bridge in order, men before horses; to send Chen Yun to Shanghai to restore the party organization and then to the Soviet Union; to collect grain; and to discuss the route north after reaching Luding. Some accounts date the meeting to 28 May and differ on attendees; this entry follows 29 May and lists only the main participants. Mao left Moxi before dawn on 30 May and received news of the bridge’s capture near Mogangling.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 12 日，中央红军先头部队红一军团第二师第四团翻越夹金山后，在达维以南、夹金山北麓木城沟与红四方面军第九军第二十五师第七十四团相遇，双方吹号联络确认身份，在达维会师桥会合。6 月 17 日，毛泽东、周恩来、朱德等率中央机关到达达维，红二十五师列队迎接；6 月 18 日中央红军主力到达懋功，与红四方面军主力会师。本坐标为达维会师桥代表点。
description.en: On 12 June 1935, the Fourth Regiment of the Second Division, First Army Corps, crossed the Jiajin Mountains and met the 74th Regiment of the 25th Division, Ninth Army, Fourth Front Army at Mucheng Gully below the mountain south of Dawei. The two sides identified each other by bugle calls and joined at the Dawei meeting bridge. On 17 June Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Zhu De, and the central organs reached Dawei, where the 25th Division lined the road to welcome them; on 18 June the main force reached Maogong and met the main force of the Fourth Front Army. The coordinate is a representative point at the Dawei meeting bridge.

summary.en: The Politburo met at Lianghekou and decided to concentrate the main force northward to create the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu base area.

description.zh: 1935 年 6 月 26 日，中央政治局在懋功以北两河口召开扩大会议，通过《关于一、四方面军会合后战略方针的决定》，决定集中主力向北进攻，在运动战中消灭敌人，首先取得甘肃南部，创造川陕甘苏区根据地。张国焘在会上表示同意，会后以“组织问题”为由拖延北上。本坐标为两河口镇代表点，会议会址待进一步落位。
description.en: On 26 June 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Lianghekou north of Maogong and adopted the “Decision on the Strategic Policy after the Meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies”. It decided to concentrate the main force for a northward attack, destroy the enemy in mobile warfare, first take southern Gansu, and create the Sichuan–Shaanxi–Gansu Soviet base. Zhang Guotao agreed at the meeting but afterwards delayed the northward move on the pretext of “organizational questions”. The coordinate is a representative point at Lianghekou; the meeting site awaits further placement.

summary.zh: 中央政治局在芦花开会，解决统一指挥与四方面军工作问题。
summary.en: The Politburo met at Luhua to settle unified command and the work of the Fourth Front Army.

description.zh: 1935 年 7 月 18 日，中央政治局常委会议在芦花召开，同意周恩来辞去红军总政委，任命张国焘为红军总政委、军委总负责者；7 月 21—22 日政治局扩大会议听取张国焘、徐向前、陈昌浩关于红四方面军的报告，肯定其成绩，批评退出鄂豫皖、放弃通南巴等错误，并决定组织前敌总指挥部，徐向前任总指挥、陈昌浩任政委、叶剑英任参谋长。本坐标为芦花镇代表点，会址待进一步落位。
description.en: On 18 July 1935 the Politburo Standing Committee met at Luhua and agreed that Zhou Enlai should resign as political commissar of the Red Army, appointing Zhang Guotao as political commissar and head of the Military Commission. On 21–22 July an enlarged Politburo meeting heard reports from Zhang Guotao, Xu Xiangqian, and Chen Changhao on the Fourth Front Army, affirmed its achievements, criticized errors including the withdrawal from the Hubei–Henan–Anhui base and the abandonment of Tongnanba, and decided to form the Front Command with Xu Xiangqian as commander, Chen Changhao as political commissar, and Ye Jianying as chief of staff. The coordinate is a representative point at Luhua; the meeting site awaits further placement.

description.zh: 1935 年 8 月 4—6 日，中央政治局在毛儿盖附近沙窝（俄灯寨）召开扩大会议，讨论红一、四方面军会合后的形势与任务及组织问题；通过《关于一、四方面军会合后的政治形势与任务的决议》，重申两河口会议北上方针，强调党对红军的绝对领导和两军团结，增补陈昌浩、周纯全为政治局委员。决议中“红军一万八千里长征”是中央文件首次正式使用“长征”一词。本坐标为俄灯寨代表点。
description.en: From 4 to 6 August 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Shawo (Edengzhai) near Maoergai to discuss the situation and tasks after the meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies, as well as organizational questions. It adopted the “Resolution on the Political Situation and Tasks after the Meeting of the First and Fourth Front Armies”, reaffirmed the northward policy of the Lianghekou meeting, stressed absolute Party leadership over the Red Army and unity between the two armies, and added Chen Changhao and Zhou Chunquan to the Politburo. The phrase “the Red Army’s 18,000-li Long March” in the resolution was the first formal use of “Long March” in a central document. The coordinate is a representative point at Edengzhai.

summary.zh: 中央在巴西召开紧急会议，决定率红一、红三军连夜北上。
summary.en: The central leadership held an emergency meeting at Baxi and decided to lead the First and Third Army Corps north that night.

description.zh: 1935 年 9 月 9 日，张国焘电令右路军南下，叶剑英获取密电后报告毛泽东。毛泽东、张闻天、博古等赶到红三军团驻地巴西，连夜召开政治局紧急会议，决定率红一、红三军和军委纵队一部立即北上，脱离险境，并发布《为执行北上方针告同志书》。9 月 10 日凌晨，中央率部离开巴西，向俄界前进。本坐标为巴西镇班佑寺代表点，阿西牙弄紧急会议会址待分别落位。
description.en: On 9 September 1935 Zhang Guotao telegraphed the right column to move south. Ye Jianying obtained the telegram and reported it to Mao Zedong. Mao, Zhang Wentian, and Bo Gu rushed to the Third Army Corps headquarters at Baxi and held an emergency Politburo meeting that night. They decided to lead the First and Third Army Corps and part of the CMC column north immediately to escape the danger, and issued the “Letter to Comrades on Carrying Out the Northward Policy”. In the early hours of 10 September the central leadership left Baxi for Ejie. The coordinate is a representative point at Banyou Temple, Baxi; the Axi Yanong emergency meeting site awaits separate placement.

summary.en: The Politburo met at Ejie, adopted the “Decision on Comrade Zhang Guotao’s Errors”, and reorganized the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment.

description.zh: 1935 年 9 月 12 日，中央政治局在甘肃迭部俄界（今高吉村）召开扩大会议，听取毛泽东关于与四方面军领导者争论及今后战略方针的报告，通过《关于张国焘同志的错误的决定》，决定将红一、红三军和军委纵队整编为中国工农红军陕甘支队，彭德怀任司令员、毛泽东任政委，并成立由毛泽东、周恩来、王稼祥、彭德怀、林彪组成的五人团。本坐标为高吉村代表点，会址待进一步落位。
description.en: On 12 September 1935 the Politburo held an enlarged meeting at Ejie (now Gaoji Village) in Diebu, Gansu. It heard Mao Zedong’s report on the dispute with the Fourth Front Army leadership and future strategy, adopted the “Decision on Comrade Zhang Guotao’s Errors”, and decided to reorganize the First and Third Army Corps and the CMC column into the Chinese Workers’ and Peasants’ Red Army Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment, with Peng Dehuai as commander and Mao Zedong as political commissar. It also formed a five-man group of Mao Zedong, Zhou Enlai, Wang Jiaxiang, Peng Dehuai, and Lin Biao. The coordinate is a representative point at Gaoji Village; the meeting site awaits further placement.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 7 日，陕甘支队翻越六盘山后，前卫在青石嘴附近抓获敌军便衣侦察员，得知东北军骑兵第七师第十九团两个连正在青石嘴休整。毛泽东决定突袭，以第四大队正面攻击、第一和第五大队两翼迂回、第十三大队后卫掩护，经约半小时战斗，歼敌 200 余人，缴获战马 100 余匹及大批弹药。红军以此组建第一支骑兵侦察连。本坐标为青石嘴村代表点，具体战场待考。
description.en: On 7 October 1935, after crossing the Liupan Mountains, the Shaanxi–Gansu Detachment’s advance guard captured enemy plainclothes scouts near Qingshizui and learned that two companies of the 19th Regiment, 7th Cavalry Division, Northeast Army, were resting there. Mao Zedong ordered a surprise attack: the 4th Battalion attacked frontally, the 1st and 5th Battalions swept the flanks, and the 13th Battalion covered the rear. In about half an hour the Red Army killed or wounded more than 200 enemy soldiers and captured over 100 horses and large quantities of ammunition. The captured horses were used to form the Red Army’s first cavalry reconnaissance company. The coordinate is a representative point at Qingshizui village; the exact battlefield awaits verification.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 8 日至 20 日，红四方面军执行《绥丹崇懋战役计划》，王树声率右纵队沿大金川南下夺取绥靖、丹巴，徐向前、陈昌浩率左纵队沿抚边河南下夺取懋功、达维。经 12 天战斗，击溃川军 6 个旅，占领绥靖、崇化、丹巴、懋功等地，为南下天全、芦山打开通道。本坐标为丹巴县城代表点，绥靖、崇化、懋功待分别落位。
description.en: From 8 to 20 October 1935, the Fourth Front Army carried out the “Suidan Chongmao Campaign Plan”. Wang Shusheng led the right column south along the Dajin River to take Suijing and Danba, while Xu Xiangqian and Chen Changhao led the left column south along the Fubian River to take Maogong and Dawei. In twelve days of fighting they routed six Sichuan brigades and occupied Suijing, Chonghua, Danba, and Maogong, opening the way south to Tianquan and Lushan. The coordinate is a representative point at Danba county town; Suijing, Chonghua, and Maogong await separate placement.

summary.en: The Central Red Army defeated the pursuing cavalry at Wuqi, the last battle of the Long March.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 19 日，中央红军到达吴起镇，国民党军骑兵追至苏区门口。20 日，红军在头道川、平台山、二道川、三道川设伏；21 日发起“切尾巴”战役，分块切割、相机包围，歼灭东北军白凤翔第六师一个骑兵团、郭希鹏第三师两个骑兵团，击溃马鸿宾部第三十五师马培清骑兵团，毙伤 600 余人，俘 1000 余人，缴获战马、驮马 1600 余匹。此役是中央红军结束长征的最后一战。本坐标为吴起镇代表点。
description.en: On 19 October 1935 the Central Red Army reached Wuqi, with KMT cavalry pursuing to the gate of the Soviet area. On 20 October the Red Army set ambushes at Toudao Creek, Pingtai Mountain, Erdao Creek, and Sandao Creek; on 21 October it launched the “Cutting the Tail” battle, cutting the enemy into blocks and encircling them. It destroyed one cavalry regiment of Bai Fengxiang’s 6th Division and two cavalry regiments of Guo Xipeng’s 3rd Division, routed Ma Peiqing’s cavalry regiment of Ma Hongbin’s 35th Division, killed or wounded more than 600, captured more than 1,000, and took over 1,600 horses and pack animals. The battle was the last of the Central Red Army’s Long March. The coordinate is a representative point at Wuqi.

summary.zh: 红四方面军南下攻占宝兴、天全、芦山、名山，百丈关受挫。
summary.en: The Fourth Front Army moved south and took Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, but was checked at Baizhang Pass.

description.zh: 1935 年 10 月 24 日至 11 月 25 日，红四方面军分左、中、右纵队从懋功、丹巴等地南下，攻占宝兴、天全、芦山、名山等地，歼敌 1 万余人，击落飞机 1 架。11 月中旬进攻百丈关，遭川军 80 余团反扑，激战 7 昼夜，伤亡近万人，被迫撤至天全、芦山、宝兴休整。此役是红四方面军南下由进攻转入防御的转折点。本坐标为芦山县城代表点。
description.en: From 24 October to 25 November 1935, the Fourth Front Army moved south in left, center, and right columns from Maogong and Danba, taking Baoxing, Tianquan, Lushan, and Mingshan, destroying more than 10,000 enemy troops, and downing one aircraft. In mid-November it attacked Baizhang Pass but was counterattacked by more than 80 Sichuan regiments; after seven days and nights of fighting it suffered nearly 10,000 casualties and withdrew to Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing. The campaign marked the Fourth Front Army’s shift from offensive to defensive in the south. The coordinate is a representative point at Lushan county town.

Designations and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Fourth Front Army fought a seven-day decisive battle with Sichuan troops at Baizhang Pass, suffered nearly 10,000 casualties, and was checked.

description.zh: 1935 年 11 月 13 日至 21 日，红四方面军以 15 个团向名山、邛崃间百丈关进攻，16 日占领百丈镇。川军刘湘调集 80 余团，在飞机大炮掩护下从北、东、南三面反扑。红军在百丈周围十余里弧形阵地浴血苦战 7 昼夜，毙伤川军 1.5 万余人，自身伤亡近万人，被迫撤出百丈，转入防御。本坐标为百丈镇代表点。
description.en: From 13 to 21 November 1935, the Fourth Front Army attacked Baizhang Pass between Mingshan and Qionglai with fifteen regiments and took Baizhang town on 16 November. Liu Xiang concentrated more than eighty Sichuan regiments and counterattacked from north, east, and south under air and artillery cover. The Red Army fought for seven days and nights in an arc-shaped position around Baizhang, killing or wounding more than 15,000 Sichuan troops while suffering nearly 10,000 casualties, and was forced to withdraw and go on the defensive. The coordinate is a representative point at Baizhang town.

summary.en: Kuomintang forces, including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling, pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups along separate routes.

description.zh: 1935 年 11 月至 1936 年 10 月，国民党军以湘军李觉纵队、中央军郭汝栋与郝梦龄等纵队分路追击红二、六军团，企图将其围歼于湘鄂川黔地区；红军突围西进，最终与红四方面军会师。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From November 1935 to October 1936, Kuomintang forces including Li Jue’s Hunan column and the Central Army columns of Guo Rudong and Hao Mengling pursued the Red Second and Sixth Army Groups, seeking to destroy them in the Hunan-Hubei-Sichuan-Guizhou region; the Red Army broke out westward and eventually joined the Red Fourth Front Army. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 红二、红六军团在芷江便水伏击湘军第十六师，掩护西进。
summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the Hunan 16th Division at Bianshui near Zhijiang, covering their westward move.

description.zh: 1936 年 1 月 5 日至 6 日，红二、红六军团在芷江、晃县间便水地区伏击尾追的湘军李觉纵队第十六师。因敌军提前侦察、伏击意图暴露，战斗转为阵地拉锯战；红军毙伤俘敌近千人，自身亦有较大伤亡，红四师参谋长金承忠、十一团团长覃耀楚牺牲。6 日黄昏撤出战斗，向黔东转移。本坐标为便水/上坪代表点。
description.en: From 5 to 6 January 1936, the Second and Sixth Army Corps ambushed the pursuing 16th Division of Li Jue’s Hunan column at Bianshui between Zhijiang and Huangxian. Enemy reconnaissance exposed the ambush, and the battle became a positional struggle. The Red Army killed, wounded, or captured nearly 1,000 enemy troops but also suffered heavy casualties; Jin Chengzhong, chief of staff of the Fourth Division, and Qin Yaochu, commander of the 11th Regiment, were killed. The Red Army withdrew at dusk on 6 January and moved toward eastern Guizhou. The coordinate is a representative point at Bianshui/Shangping.

description.en: On 2 February 1936, the advance guard of the Second and Sixth Army Corps rushed the Yachihe ferry, secured the south bank, captured four wooden boats, and with local boatmen built a pontoon bridge overnight. More than 18,000 troops crossed the Yachi River over three days and entered Qianxi, Dading, and Bijie, opening the door to northwestern Guizhou. The coordinate is a representative point at the old Yachihe ferry.

summary.en: The Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing and moved north again via Danba, Daofu, Luhuo, and Ganzi.

description.zh: 1936 年 2 月中旬，红四方面军撤离天全、芦山、宝兴地区，再次翻越夹金山，经达维、懋功、丹巴向西转移；3 月 1 日先头部队攻占道孚，15 日占炉霍，随后占领甘孜。7 月初与红二、六军团在甘孜会师，随后共同北上。本坐标为甘孜县城代表点，具体行军路线待细化。
description.en: In mid-February 1936 the Fourth Front Army withdrew from Tianquan, Lushan, and Baoxing, crossed the Jiajin Mountains again, and moved west via Dawei, Maogong, and Danba. On 1 March its advance guard took Daofu, on 15 March Luhuo, and then Ganzi. In early July it met the Second and Sixth Army Corps at Ganzi and moved north together. The coordinate is a representative point at Ganzi county town; the exact route awaits refinement.

summary.en: The Second and Sixth Army Corps met at Jiujianlou in Panxian and decided to cross the Jinsha River north to join the Fourth Front Army.

description.zh: 1936 年 3 月 30 日夜，红二、红六军团在盘县九间楼召开会议，传达红军总部电示，分析全国形势，决定放弃在南北盘江建立根据地，立即北渡金沙江，与红四方面军会合、共同北上抗日。4 月 1 日撤离盘县。本坐标为九间楼代表点。
description.en: On the night of 30 March 1936, the Second and Sixth Army Corps met at Jiujianlou in Panxian. They relayed the Red Army headquarters’ instructions, analyzed the national situation, and decided to abandon plans for a base between the north and south Pan rivers. Instead they would cross the Jinsha River north to join the Fourth Front Army and move north together to resist Japan. They left Panxian on 1 April. The coordinate is a representative point at Jiujianlou.

description.zh: 1936 年 4 月 8 日，红二军团第四师先头部队抢占禄劝普渡河渡口，与滇军孙渡纵队激战；红四师大部从铁索桥下涉水过河，红六军团前卫第十七师在普渡河与滇军遭遇，渡河受阻。红军被迫调整部署，转至六甲阻击。本坐标为普渡河铁索桥代表点。
description.en: On 8 April 1936, the advance guard of the Fourth Division, Second Army Corps, seized the Pudu River crossing in Luquan and fought Sun Du’s Yunnan column. Most of the Fourth Division forded the river below the chain bridge, while the Seventeenth Division, vanguard of the Sixth Army Corps, met the Yunnan troops at the Pudu River and was blocked. The Red Army adjusted its deployment and turned to block the enemy at Liujia. The coordinate is a representative point at the Pudu River chain bridge.

summary.zh: 红六师在六甲阻击滇军，掩护主力西进。
summary.en: The Sixth Division blocked the Yunnan army at Liujia, covering the main force’s westward move.

description.zh: 1936 年 4 月 9 日，红二军团第六师在寻甸六甲石蜡坨垭口阻击尾追的滇军第七旅，红十六、十七、十八团抢占垭口南北山冈，激战至傍晚，红五师增援从侧后夹击，滇军溃退。红军以伤亡 200 余人代价歼敌近千人，粉碎滇军将红军消灭于普渡河以东、功山以南的计划。本坐标为六甲/贾白山代表点。
description.en: On 9 April 1936, the Sixth Division of the Second Army Corps blocked the pursuing 7th Brigade of the Yunnan army at the Shilatuo pass in Liujia, Xundian. The 16th, 17th, and 18th Regiments seized the high ground north and south of the pass and fought until evening, when the Fifth Division arrived and attacked the enemy flank and rear, routing the Yunnan troops. The Red Army suffered more than 200 casualties and killed or wounded nearly 1,000 enemy soldiers, foiling the plan to destroy the Red Army east of the Pudu River and south of Gongshan. The coordinate is a representative point at Liujia/Jiabaishan.

description.en: On October 9, 1936, the First and Fourth Front Armies met at Huining, Gansu. On October 22, the Second Front Army met the First at Jiangtaibao, Xiji, Ningxia, bringing the Long March to a victorious end.
